name: Generative AI for Business Professionals and Leaders
certifications: No single required certification; assessed by workflow portfolios, a pilot plan and a strategy presentation
Optional: vendor learning paths for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Google Gemini or ChatGPT
Supports the AI literacy duty in Article 4 of the EU AI Act

beginner.summary: For non-technical professionals in any function who want to use generative AI safely and productively at work. Covers what generative AI is, how language models work in plain terms, choosing assistants, prompting for business tasks, writing, summarising, research with source checking, spreadsheet analysis, presentations and images, customer communication, custom assistants, hallucinations, privacy and confidentiality, copyright, bias, company AI policy, uses in each business function, measuring time saved and building daily habits.
prerequisites: Uses email, documents and spreadsheets at work
No programming or data science needed
Has access to at least one approved AI assistant or a practice account
outcomes: Use AI assistants to draft, summarise, research and analyse work tasks with clear prompts
Check AI output for errors and protect confidential data
Follow company AI policy and handle copyright and bias risks
Measure the time and quality gained in your own work

days.topic: Generative AI for Business Overview: What It Is and What It Is Not
subtopics: What generative AI means for everyday work
Text, image, audio and video generation
What AI does well: drafting, summarising and reformatting
What AI does badly: facts without sources, arithmetic, judgement
Examples from HR, finance, sales, marketing and operations
Myths about AI replacing whole jobs
How the course works: real tasks from your role
days.lab_task: List ten recurring tasks from your week, mark which suit AI help and which do not, try one simple task with an approved assistant and record the time it took.
days.deliverable: Task list with AI suitability and a first timed attempt
checks: Each task is marked suitable or unsuitable with a reason
One task is completed with AI help and reviewed by you
Three goals for the course are written
objectives: Explain generative AI in plain words

days.topic: How Large Language Models Work in Plain Terms
subtopics: Predicting the next word from patterns
Why answers sound confident when wrong
Context windows and why long chats drift
Knowledge cut-off dates and web search
Why the same question gets different answers
days.lab_task: Ask the same three questions twice in different chats, compare the answers, test one question with and without web search and explain the differences in plain words.
checks: Differences between repeated answers are recorded
The effect of web search on a factual question is shown
Each difference is explained in plain words
objectives: Explain how language models produce answers

days.topic: Choosing AI Assistants at Work: ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini and Claude
subtopics: The main assistants and their strengths
Assistants built into Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace
Consumer accounts compared with business accounts
File uploads, web search and connectors
Choosing the right tool for a task
days.lab_task: Run the same three work tasks in two approved assistants, compare quality, speed and data handling, and write which tool you will use for each kind of task.
days.deliverable: Tool comparison and personal tool choices
checks: Both tools are rated on quality and speed for three tasks
Data handling of each tool is noted from company guidance
Each task type has a chosen tool with a reason

days.topic: Prompting for Everyday Business Tasks
subtopics: Giving examples of the output you want
Asking the assistant to ask you questions
Prompts that save the most time
days.lab_task: Rewrite five weak prompts from your own work into clear prompts with role, context and format, compare the outputs and save the best three as reusable templates.
days.deliverable: Five improved prompts and three templates
checks: Each rewritten prompt has context and an output format
Better outputs are shown side by side with the originals
Three templates are saved for future use

days.topic: Writing and Editing with AI: Emails, Reports and Proposals
days.lab_task: Draft a customer email, a status report and a short proposal with AI from your own notes, edit each into your voice and record every fact you had to correct.
days.deliverable: Three edited documents with a correction log
checks: All three documents are drafted from your notes
Final versions sound like you and suit the reader

days.topic: Summarising Documents, Meetings and Long Threads
subtopics: Action items and decisions from meetings
days.lab_task: Summarise a long document, a meeting transcript and an email thread for two different readers, check every summary against its source and list what the AI got wrong or left out.
checks: Errors and omissions are listed for each summary
Meeting summary follows recording and consent rules

days.topic: Research with AI and Checking Sources
subtopics: Research assistants and web search modes
Checking that sources exist and say what is claimed
Research you should not delegate to AI
tools: Approved AI assistant with web search
days.lab_task: Research a market or policy question with an AI assistant, open and check every cited source, mark which claims were supported and write a short brief with only verified facts.
days.deliverable: Verified research brief and source check log
checks: Every cited source is opened and checked
Unsupported or invented claims are marked
The brief contains only verified facts with links

days.topic: Spreadsheet and Data Analysis with AI Assistants
subtopics: Formulas explained and written by AI
Charts and pivot tables with AI help
When to ask an analyst instead
tools: Microsoft Excel with Copilot or Google Sheets with Gemini
days.lab_task: Use an AI assistant to clean a sales sheet, write three formulas, build a pivot and a chart, then check two of the numbers by hand and note any mistakes.
days.deliverable: Analysed spreadsheet with a manual check
checks: The pivot and chart answer the business question
Two figures are checked by hand
No restricted data is uploaded to unapproved tools

days.topic: Presentations, Visuals and Image Generation
subtopics: Outlines and slide drafts with AI
Rights and disclosure for generated images
tools: PowerPoint with Copilot or Google Slides with Gemini
days.lab_task: Turn a report into a ten-slide draft with AI, rewrite headlines to make the point, generate one image that follows brand rules and review the deck for errors.
checks: The deck is created from the report
Headlines state the point on every slide
The generated image follows brand and disclosure rules

days.topic: Customer Communication with AI: Replies, FAQs and Tone
days.lab_task: Draft replies to five customer messages including a complaint, build three FAQ answers from a policy document and check every reply for accuracy and personal data.
checks: Replies are polite, accurate and complete
FAQ answers match the policy document
Personal data is handled as the policy requires

days.topic: Custom Assistants: GPTs, Gems, Projects and Copilot Agents
subtopics: Rules for data in custom assistants
tools: ChatGPT custom GPTs or Claude Projects
days.lab_task: Build a custom assistant for one repeated team task with instructions and approved knowledge files, test it with ten realistic requests and fix the weak answers.
checks: Instructions and knowledge files are set

days.topic: Hallucinations and How to Check AI Output
subtopics: Asking the AI to critique itself
days.lab_task: Find the errors in five AI answers prepared by the trainer, then use your checking routine on three of your own AI outputs and record what you found.
days.deliverable: Error log and personal checking routine
checks: Three of your outputs are checked with the routine
Each error is rated by its business impact

days.topic: Privacy, Confidentiality and Company Data
subtopics: What happens to data in AI tools
Data protection laws such as GDPR and India's DPDP Act in brief
days.lab_task: Classify ten sample pieces of information under your company's rules, anonymise two documents before using AI with them and write what you would do after pasting something by mistake.
days.deliverable: Classification exercise, anonymised documents and incident steps
checks: Names and identifiers are removed before use

days.topic: Copyright, Intellectual Property and AI-Generated Content
subtopics: Disclosure of AI use to clients
When to ask the legal team
days.lab_task: Work through six content scenarios covering marketing copy, images, client deliverables and code, decide whether each is acceptable and what disclosure or checks are needed.
checks: Each scenario has a decision with reasons
Cases needing legal review are flagged
objectives: Know when to involve legal teams

days.topic: Bias and Fairness in Everyday AI Use
subtopics: Where bias in AI comes from
Stereotypes in job descriptions and marketing
days.lab_task: Generate a job advert and two marketing images, check them for biased language and stereotypes with a checklist, fix the problems and note which decisions must stay with people.
checks: Biased wording and images are identified
People decisions that must not be automated are listed

days.topic: Your Company's AI Policy and Approved Tools
subtopics: Roles and approvals for new uses
days.lab_task: Read your company's AI policy or a sample policy, answer ten scenario questions from it and suggest two improvements that would make it easier to follow.
checks: Unclear parts of the policy are listed

days.topic: AI in Your Function: HR, Finance, Sales, Marketing and Operations
subtopics: Common uses in operations and supply chain
Limits and risks in each function
days.lab_task: Choose your function, test three common uses on realistic tasks, record time saved and risks, and present the best use to the group.
checks: Three uses are tested on realistic tasks
Time saved and risks are recorded
The best use is presented with evidence

days.topic: Measuring Time Saved and Quality Gained
subtopics: Measuring time with and without AI
Spotting tasks where AI slows you down
Using results to decide what to keep
days.lab_task: Time five tasks with and without AI help, rate quality with a rubric, count corrections and report net time saved for each task.
checks: Time with and without AI is recorded for five tasks
Each output is scored on the rubric
Tasks where AI does not help are identified

days.topic: Building Personal AI Habits and Workflows
subtopics: Daily and weekly uses that stick
days.lab_task: Design two personal workflows that combine AI steps with your own checks, use them for a week of simulated tasks and write a personal AI plan.
days.deliverable: Two workflows and a personal AI plan
checks: Each workflow includes a human checking step
Workflows are used on several tasks
The plan lists habits, limits and learning goals

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: AI-Assisted Workflow for a Real Task
days.lab_task: Choose a real recurring task, design an AI-assisted workflow with checking and policy steps, run it three times, measure time and quality and present the results to the group.
checks: The workflow includes data, checking and policy steps
Time and quality are measured over three runs
Results and limits are presented clearly
objectives: Apply AI to a real task safely

intermediate.summary: For managers, team leads, process owners and business analysts who lead generative AI adoption in a team or function. Covers finding and prioritising use cases, business cases, process redesign, knowledge assistants on company documents, no-code automation and agents, evaluating output quality, running pilots, change management, training teams, risk assessment and governance, choosing vendors, data readiness, regulation for AI users, and uses in customer service, sales and marketing, HR, finance and legal, ending with measuring adoption and return on investment.
prerequisites: Uses AI assistants confidently for their own work
Manages a team, process or budget, or supports someone who does
outcomes: Find, prioritise and justify generative AI use cases with a business case
Run a measured pilot with clear quality checks and decisions
Lead adoption, training and change for a team
Manage risk, vendors, data and regulation for AI in a function

days.topic: Finding Generative AI Use Cases in a Team or Function
subtopics: Mapping the team's work into tasks
Looking for volume, repetition and text-heavy work
Use cases in customer-facing and internal work
Ideas from other companies and vendors
days.lab_task: Interview three role-played colleagues, map their work into tasks and build a use case register with at least ten candidate uses for your team.
days.deliverable: Use case register with task evidence
checks: Each use case links to tasks from interviews
Each entry states the problem, users and expected benefit
Uses that do not suit generative AI are removed with reasons
objectives: Find use cases from real work

days.topic: Prioritising Use Cases: Value, Feasibility and Risk
subtopics: Value: time, quality, revenue and customer impact
Dependencies on IT and data teams
days.lab_task: Score the use case register on value, feasibility and risk, choose three priorities and agree them with a role-played department head.
checks: Every use case has value, feasibility and risk scores
Three priorities are chosen with reasons
The department head accepts or adjusts the priorities

days.topic: Writing a Business Case for an AI Initiative
subtopics: Expected benefits and how to measure them
What success looks like at three and twelve months
days.lab_task: Write a business case for one priority use case with baseline costs, measurable benefits, full costs, risks and scenarios, and present the one-page summary to a role-played approver.
checks: Costs and benefits are calculated with stated assumptions
Training and change costs are included
The approver's questions are answered from the case

days.topic: Redesigning Processes Around AI
subtopics: Adding AI to a process compared with redesigning it
Where AI drafts, checks or decides
days.lab_task: Map a current process such as invoice queries or job applications, redesign it with AI steps and human review points, and estimate the effect on time and errors.
days.deliverable: Current and redesigned process maps with estimates
checks: The current process is mapped with times
AI steps and human checks are placed with reasons
Time and error effects are estimated

days.topic: Knowledge Assistants on Company Documents: Retrieval in Plain Terms
subtopics: Permissions and who can see what
days.lab_task: Set up a knowledge assistant on a policy library, test it with twenty real employee questions, record wrong and missing answers and fix the document problems behind them.
days.deliverable: Tested knowledge assistant and document fixes
checks: The assistant answers from the chosen documents
Twenty questions are rated for accuracy and citations
Document gaps behind wrong answers are fixed

days.topic: No-Code AI Automation and Agents: Copilot Studio, Power Automate and Zapier
subtopics: Agents that take actions in business tools
Power Automate and Zapier AI steps
days.lab_task: Build a no-code automation that classifies incoming requests with AI, drafts a reply for human approval and logs the result, and test it with fifteen requests.
checks: The automation runs from trigger to log
Replies are sent only after approval
Fifteen requests are processed and errors reviewed

days.topic: Evaluating AI Output Quality for Business Tasks
subtopics: Defining good output for a task
days.lab_task: Build a rubric and a test set of twenty real examples for one use case, score two prompts or tools with subject experts and set an acceptable quality threshold.
days.deliverable: Rubric, test set and scored comparison
checks: The rubric covers accuracy, tone and completeness
Both options are scored on the same examples
The acceptable error rate is agreed with experts

days.topic: Running an AI Pilot: Scope, Measures and Decisions
days.lab_task: Plan a four-week pilot with baseline measures and decision criteria, analyse simulated pilot results and recommend go, change or stop.
checks: Baseline measures and decision criteria are set before the pilot
Results are compared with the baseline

days.topic: Change Management and Adoption for AI Tools
subtopics: Making AI part of daily routines
days.lab_task: Write a change plan for rolling out an AI assistant to a team of fifty, with messages, champions, routines and adoption measures, and role-play a conversation with a worried employee.
checks: The plan covers messages, champions and measures
The conversation addresses job concerns honestly

days.topic: Training a Team to Use AI Well
subtopics: AI literacy duties under the EU AI Act
days.lab_task: Survey a team's AI skills, design a role-based training plan with practice tasks and a shared prompt library, and define how skill growth will be measured.
days.deliverable: Skills survey results and training plan
checks: Skills gaps are identified by role
Training uses real tasks for each role

days.topic: AI Risk Assessment and Governance for Managers
days.lab_task: Complete a risk assessment for two use cases, choose controls, route one through the approval process and record both in the AI use register.
days.deliverable: Two risk assessments and register entries
checks: Risks are rated for likelihood and severity
Each high risk has a control
Both uses are recorded in the register

days.topic: Choosing AI Vendors and Tools: Procurement Questions
subtopics: Build compared with buy for a team
Data handling and training on customer data
Pricing models: seats, usage and add-ons
days.lab_task: Compare three vendors for a use case on capability, data handling, security, cost and integration, run a short proof of value with one and write a recommendation.
days.deliverable: Vendor comparison, proof of value and recommendation
checks: Vendors are scored on the same criteria
Data use and training terms are recorded

days.topic: Data Readiness for Generative AI
days.lab_task: Audit a team's document library for outdated, duplicate and overshared content, fix the top problems and score data readiness before and after.
checks: Outdated, duplicate and overshared items are found

days.topic: Regulation for AI Users: EU AI Act, DPDP Act and Sector Rules
subtopics: Why regulation matters to business users
Risk categories in the EU AI Act
Sector rules in finance, health and HR
Working with legal and compliance teams
days.lab_task: Classify five use cases against EU AI Act risk categories and data protection rules, list the duties for each and agree actions with a role-played compliance officer.
checks: Each use case has a risk category with reasons
Transparency and data duties are listed
The compliance officer agrees the actions

days.topic: Generative AI in Customer Service
tools: Help desk platform with AI features
days.lab_task: Design an AI-assisted service model with agent assist, a chatbot with handover rules and quality monitoring, and define the service measures to track.
checks: Agent assist, chatbot and handover rules are defined
Disclosure and escalation rules are included
Service measures have baselines and targets

days.topic: Generative AI in Sales and Marketing
days.lab_task: Build an AI-assisted campaign with researched personas, personalised messages within consent rules and on-brand content, and define how its impact will be measured.
checks: Messages are personalised from approved data
Consent and brand rules are followed
objectives: Apply AI in sales and marketing

days.topic: Generative AI in HR and Recruitment: Uses and Risks
days.lab_task: Use AI to draft a job advert, interview questions and onboarding content, check each for bias, and write the rules that keep hiring and performance decisions with people.
days.deliverable: HR content and people decision rules
checks: Advert, questions and onboarding content are produced
Decisions that must stay human are written

days.topic: Generative AI in Finance, Legal and Procurement
subtopics: Confidentiality of financial and legal data
days.lab_task: Use AI to draft variance commentary, review a sample contract against a checklist and compare suppliers, then check each output against source documents and record an audit trail.
days.deliverable: Finance, legal and procurement outputs with audit trail
checks: Commentary, review and comparison are completed
Each output is checked against the sources
The audit trail shows prompts, sources and reviewer
objectives: Apply AI in finance, legal and procurement

days.topic: Measuring Adoption, Value and Return on Investment
subtopics: Adoption measures: active users and frequency
Value measures: time, quality, revenue and cost
Stopping uses that do not pay back
days.lab_task: Build a value dashboard for an AI rollout from sample usage, survey and business data, compare results with the business case and recommend what to expand and stop.
checks: Adoption and value measures are shown
Results are compared with the business case
objectives: Decide what to scale or stop

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Pilot Plan for a Team Use Case
days.lab_task: Build a complete pilot pack for a real team use case: business case, redesigned process, risk assessment, quality test set, change plan and decision criteria, and present it to a role-played steering group.
days.deliverable: Pilot pack and steering group presentation
checks: The business case and risks support the pilot
Quality tests and decision criteria are defined
The steering group approves or sets conditions

advanced.summary: For executives, directors and transformation leads responsible for generative AI across an organisation. Covers AI strategy, operating models, use case portfolios, build or buy decisions, technology choices for leaders, cost management, board-level governance, compliance programmes, enterprise AI risk, security threats, workforce planning and reskilling, agentic AI in operations, scaling from pilots, customer trust, intellectual property, value measurement, vendor negotiation, sustainability and communicating AI strategy.
prerequisites: Leads a function, business unit or transformation programme
Has sponsored or run AI pilots, or completed intermediate training
Takes part in investment and risk decisions
outcomes: Set a generative AI strategy and operating model linked to business goals
Govern AI risk, regulation, security and ethics at enterprise level
Plan the workforce, cost and technology choices that make AI scale
Measure enterprise AI value and communicate strategy to boards and employees

days.topic: Generative AI Strategy Linked to Business Strategy
subtopics: Where AI changes the business model
Linking AI goals to company goals
days.lab_task: Write a one-page generative AI strategy for a case company with focus areas, ambitions, guardrails and links to company goals, and test it against two competitor moves.
checks: Each focus area supports a company goal
The strategy states what the company will not do
The strategy holds up against two competitor scenarios

days.topic: AI Operating Models: Centres of Excellence and Federated Teams
subtopics: Responsibilities of an AI centre of excellence
days.lab_task: Design an AI operating model for a case company with a centre of excellence, business unit leads, shared services and decision rights, and compare it with an alternative.
checks: Roles, services and decision rights are defined
The alternative model is compared with reasons

days.topic: Managing an AI Use Case Portfolio
subtopics: Balancing quick wins and transformational bets
Stage gates from idea to scale
days.lab_task: Review a portfolio of fifteen AI initiatives, apply stage gate and kill criteria, reallocate the budget and present the revised portfolio.
checks: Each initiative is assessed against stage gate criteria
At least one initiative is stopped with reasons

days.topic: Build, Buy or Partner for AI Capabilities
days.lab_task: Decide build, buy or partner for three AI capabilities in a case company with total cost, speed, control and lock-in, and record each decision.
days.deliverable: Three build, buy or partner decisions
checks: Options are compared on cost, speed and control

days.topic: Technology Choices for Leaders: Models, Platforms and Data
days.lab_task: Review a proposed AI technology plan from a role-played CTO, ask the key questions, identify two risks and agree changes to the technology roadmap.
days.deliverable: Review notes and agreed roadmap changes
checks: The key questions are asked and answered

days.topic: AI Cost Management: Licences, Tokens and Infrastructure
subtopics: Cost types: seats, usage and infrastructure
Cost per task and per outcome
days.lab_task: Build a twelve-month cost forecast for an AI rollout with seat and usage costs, find unused licences in sample data and propose controls that cut cost without hurting value.
checks: Seat and usage costs are forecast with assumptions
Controls keep value while cutting cost

days.topic: Responsible AI Governance at Board Level
subtopics: The board's role in AI oversight
days.lab_task: Draft an AI governance framework with principles, a committee charter and a risk appetite statement, and present a board paper on AI oversight to a mock board.
checks: Principles, committees and policies are defined
The risk appetite statement is specific
The mock board approves or asks for changes

days.topic: AI Regulation Compliance Programmes
subtopics: EU AI Act obligations by role
days.lab_task: Build an AI system inventory for a case company, classify systems by regulatory obligations and write a twelve-month compliance roadmap with owners.
checks: All AI systems are listed with owners
Obligations are identified for each system
The roadmap has milestones and owners

days.topic: Enterprise AI Risk: Model, Third-Party and Operational Risk
subtopics: AI in the enterprise risk framework
days.lab_task: Add AI risks to an enterprise risk register with key risk indicators, assess one vendor's AI risk and run a tabletop exercise for an AI incident.
days.deliverable: Updated risk register, vendor assessment and exercise notes
checks: AI risks have owners and indicators
The vendor assessment identifies key risks
The tabletop exercise produces lessons and actions

days.topic: AI Security Threats: Prompt Injection, Data Leakage and Shadow AI
subtopics: The AI threat landscape for leaders
days.lab_task: Review AI security threats for a case company with a role-played CISO, choose controls for the top five threats and plan an employee awareness campaign including deepfake fraud.
days.deliverable: Threat review, controls and awareness plan
checks: The top five threats are chosen with reasons
Each threat has controls and owners
The campaign covers deepfake fraud and shadow AI

days.topic: Workforce Planning, Reskilling and Job Redesign for AI
subtopics: How AI changes tasks and roles
Working with unions and works councils
days.lab_task: Analyse how AI changes three job families in a case company, plan reskilling and redeployment, and present a fair transition plan to role-played HR and employee representatives.
checks: Task changes are analysed for each job family

days.topic: Agentic AI in Enterprise Operations
subtopics: What AI agents can do in operations
Agents in finance, IT, HR and customer operations
days.lab_task: Assess three agent use cases for autonomy level, controls and accountability, choose one to pilot and write its oversight plan.
checks: Autonomy level and risks are rated for each use case
Approvals and action limits are defined
Accountability for agent decisions is clear

days.topic: Scaling from Pilots to Production
days.lab_task: Assess a successful pilot against production readiness criteria, plan a three-wave rollout with support and training and identify the process changes needed.
checks: Waves, support and training are scheduled
Process and policy changes are listed with owners

days.topic: Customer Trust, Transparency and AI Disclosure
days.lab_task: Write AI disclosure and explanation standards for customer-facing uses, test them with role-played customers and define trust measures to track.
checks: Standards cover disclosure, explanation and human contact

days.topic: Intellectual Property, Content Provenance and Brand Risk
subtopics: Protecting company IP in AI tools
days.lab_task: Write an AI content and IP policy for a case company covering ownership, provenance and brand use, and plan the response to a deepfake of the CEO.
days.deliverable: AI content and IP policy and incident plan
checks: The policy covers ownership, inputs, outputs and provenance
Brand rules for AI content are included
The deepfake response plan has steps and owners

days.topic: Measuring AI Value at Enterprise Scale
subtopics: Productivity, quality, growth and risk reduction
days.lab_task: Build an enterprise AI value framework and dashboard from sample data, test one value claim with a control comparison and correct two inflated claims in a sample report.
days.deliverable: Value framework, dashboard and corrected report
checks: The framework covers productivity, quality, growth and risk
One claim is tested with a comparison group
Inflated claims are corrected with evidence

days.topic: AI Vendor Ecosystem and Contract Negotiation
subtopics: Platform vendors, model providers and specialists
days.lab_task: Prepare and run a role-played negotiation for an enterprise AI contract covering price, data terms, indemnity, service levels and exit, and record the outcome.
checks: Goals, limits and alternatives are planned
Data, IP and exit terms are addressed
The outcome stays within the planned limits

days.topic: Sustainability and Energy Use of AI
subtopics: Energy and water use of AI
days.lab_task: Estimate the footprint of a company's AI use from sample data, propose three reductions that keep value and write the sustainability section of the AI report.
days.deliverable: Footprint estimate, reductions and report section
checks: The footprint estimate states its assumptions
The report section is clear and honest

days.topic: Communicating AI Strategy to Employees, Boards and Investors
days.lab_task: Write an AI narrative, deliver a town hall message with hard questions from employees, and brief a mock board and investors on progress and risks.
days.deliverable: Narrative, town hall recording and board briefing
checks: The narrative links AI to strategy and people
Hard questions about jobs are answered honestly
The board briefing covers progress, value and risk

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Generative AI Transformation Roadmap
days.lab_task: Build a three-year generative AI transformation roadmap for a case company covering strategy, operating model, portfolio, governance, workforce, costs and value, and present it to a mock executive committee.
checks: The roadmap links strategy, portfolio and value
Governance, risk and workforce plans are included
The committee approves or sets specific conditions
